# MTR night crossing (original)

Elevated metro above a night harbour for ui-kit. The picture — a silver EMU with a red stripe and red doors, concrete guideway, and lit skyline — is original art in `metro.js`.

`mtr.html` plays it with the same local halftone player as the viaduct train and the harbour ferry: 192×108 square cells, 15fps, dots on black. The train cruises at 11 cells per second and leaves the frame briefly each loop. `prefers-reduced-motion` holds one frame with the train centred.
